args.sql:
WITH light_sensitivity AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.artregistry AS "Registry Number", 
        t1.artname AS "Name", 
        t1.mattype AS "Material Type", 
        t2.lightsensitivity AS "Light Sensitivity", 
        CASE 
            WHEN t2.lightsensitivity = 'High' THEN 50 
            WHEN t2.lightsensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 200 
            ELSE NULL 
        END AS safe_light_level,
        MAX(t3.lightlux) AS max_light_level
    FROM artifactscore AS t1
    JOIN sensitivitydata AS t2 ON t1.artregistry = t2.artref
    JOIN lightandradiationreadings AS t3
    GROUP BY t1.artregistry, t1.artname, t1.mattype, t2.lightsensitivity
)
SELECT 
    "Registry Number",
    "Name",
    "Material Type",
    "Light Sensitivity",
    CASE 
        WHEN max_light_level > safe_light_level THEN 'Over Exposure'
        ELSE 'Within Limits'
    END AS "Current Status"
FROM light_sensitivity;
